# xkbcomp keymap dump + upload against Xorg (issue #171): Xvfb -noreset, layout=gb
# server: X.Org version 21.1.24 (xdpyinfo); `Xvfb -version` -> "Unrecognized option: -version" (not supported by this build)
# pacman -Q: xkeyboard-config 2.48-1 xorg-server-xvfb 21.1.24-1
# setxkbmap -rules evdev -model pc105 -layout gb; then, both under x11trace -n:
#   xkbcomp -xkb $DISPLAY dump.xkb                (dump)
#   xkbcomp dump-edited.xkb $DISPLAY              (upload; <AC01>/<AC02> symbols swapped)
# request lines: seq(hex) bytes decoded-request; XKB Set* headers decoded from the raw bytes
# (field names as in XKBproto.h; a+b = first+count). The upload runs as a probe 'run:' step,
# so the listener events and the XkbGetMap delta it caused follow (grammar as in
# xorg-xkb-change-keyboard-mapping.txt).
